GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, headed turn and dropped out # led/gone turn

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced fiercely in the early stages. Near the 600m had to be steadied after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, led a half length 3 Wide entering first turn, laid out and Headed rounding first turn, trailed 2 Lengths Two Wide by the 1000m, held together much same to turn then Lost Ground in Straight # no real excuses

Jumped only fairly then worked up to 1 length 3 Wide settling down, pressed forward and Two Wide Outside Lead at 950m, Drifted Back to 1.25 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # wide/worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, App O. Dalton stated that the mare settled worse than midfield and travelled only fairly. O. Dalton added that Jewels Statement failed to respond to her riding in the home straight and raced like a tired horse. A post-race veterinary examination of Jewels Statement did not reveal any abnormalities. Trainer S. McGuren stated that the mares form suggests it races best with a strong senior rider and she will make such engagements in future race starts. Ms McGuren added that she would assess the mare in the coming days before making a determination on its immediate racing future.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 3 Lengths rail turning, Lost Ground in straight. (Blinkers AGAIN) # never a threat

Jumped okay & Settled Down Mid Field 6.5 Lengths on fence (good pace), Drifted Back to 11 Lengths Two Wide turning (leader led 4 lengths), only Held Ground in Straight (as leaders came back) # never a factor
Jumped Well held rail half off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up half off, found little and dropped out # weak run home

Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Held Ground until pushed to quicken @ 400m. Pushed along Two Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. No improvement in straight. Rider - needs further. Vetted clear. # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that the gelding began well from an inside barrier but was not able to show sufficient pace to maintain a forward position. He said that the horse may now be better suited over a longer distance where it can race more prominently. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1.5 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, drifted off rail turning, Headed 220m, kept trying but weakened a little to the line # weak once headed

Bit Slow Out Not Bustled Drifted Back eased off heels Settled Down rear 12 Lengths Good Pace on, Ridden Along Turning for home clear run home Inside had too much to do but Kept Trying albeit not quick enough - # got too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled 4th rails 4 Lengths 600m, stayed back inside Straightening Up , battled on well to be Just behind placings # held ground
